summary: Compiled TikZ reconstruction of the semicircle figure (version 3, best critic score 0.92, must_repair=false). Contents: upper semicircle arc from M through P to N (centre O, radius ~237 px), diameter MN, segment OP, point A on OP, point B on the arc, segments AB and OB, with filled dots at O, A, B and labels M, N, O, P, A, B. Labels and vertices were bound by CV (Hungarian, NCC 0.85–0.95) and confirmed by critic label check. No right angles claimed (none verified).
